ruth.4.p1.b1.text: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there.

ruth.4.p1.b2.text: Soon the kinsman-redeemer of whom he had spoken came along

ruth.4.p1.b3.text: Come over here, my friend, and sit down.

ruth.4.p2.b1.text: Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.

ruth.4.p2.b3.text: On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance.

ruth.4.p2.b4.text: I cannot redeem it myself, or I would jeopardize my own inheritance.

ruth.4.p3.b1.text: Now in former times in Israel, concerning the redemption or exchange of property, to make any matter legally binding a man would remove his sandal and give it to the other party, and this was a confirmation in Israel.

ruth.4.p3.b3.text: You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.

ruth.4.p3.b4.text: Moreover, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, … You are witnesses today.

ruth.4.p4.b2.text: May the LORD make the woman entering your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel.

ruth.4.p4.b3.text: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring the LORD will give you by this young woman.

ruth.4.p5.b1.text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. …

ruth.4.p5.b2.text: The LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.

ruth.4.p6.b1.text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer.

ruth.4.p6.b2.text: … your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, …

ruth.4.p6.b3.text: And Naomi took the child, placed him on her lap, and became a nurse to him.

ruth.4.p7.b1.text: A son has been born to Naomi

ruth.4.p7.b3.text: He became the father of Jesse, the father of David.

ruth.4.p8.b1.text: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron

ruth.4.p8.b2.text: … Boaz was the father of Obed, Obed was the father of Jesse, and Jesse was the father of David.
